scope: Retrospective research evaluation only. This document does not authorize public alerts, operational warnings, or deterministic earthquake predictions.

forecast_unit.name: CORRIDOR_LEVEL_WINDOW
forecast_unit.description: One research forecast window for the complete unsegmented PER-NORTE-01 V1 corridor.

exploratory_trigger.description: Dutchsinse-like exploratory trigger, scored separately from the primary test.

trigger_rules.spatial_trigger_rule: A trigger event must be within 150 km of PER-NORTE-01 V1. Sensitivity results at 50 km and 100 km must also be reported.

forecast_window.rule: All three durations must be scored; the 7-day result is primary.

target_event_rules.target_geometry: Complete PER-NORTE-01 V1 corridor, without S01-S04 segments.
target_event_rules.target_time_rule: Target event_datetime_utc must fall inside an open forecast window.

forecast_deduplication.overlapping_trigger_rule: Triggers of the same test type occurring while a forecast window is open do not create an additional forecast. The existing window remains anchored to the first trigger and is not extended.
forecast_deduplication.primary_and_exploratory_separation: Primary and exploratory trigger streams are evaluated independently.
forecast_deduplication.new_window_rule: A new forecast may open only after the previous window of the same test type has closed.

target_deduplication.first_qualifying_target: The first qualifying target event in an open window determines whether that forecast is a hit.
target_deduplication.additional_targets: Additional qualifying events are retained in the event log but do not create extra hits for the same forecast window.
target_deduplication.aftershock_policy: No aftershock exclusion is applied in V1 because the catalog lacks a frozen declustering rule. All qualifying events are reported, and target-window scoring remains one hit maximum per forecast.

outcome_definitions.HIT: An open forecast window contains at least one qualifying target event within the selected corridor-distance band.
outcome_definitions.FALSE_ALARM: A forecast window closes without a qualifying target event.
outcome_definitions.FALSE_NEGATIVE: A qualifying target event occurs within the selected corridor-distance band while no forecast window of that test type is open.
outcome_definitions.TARGET_OUTSIDE_CORRIDOR: A catalog event meets the magnitude threshold but lies outside the selected corridor-distance band; it is reported but is not a target for that band.
outcome_definitions.TRIGGER_ONLY: A trigger event opens a window but is not automatically counted as its own target event.

magnitude_prediction.rule: V1 does not predict a target magnitude. Magnitude is used only as a minimum target threshold.

directionality.rule: SOUTHBOUND_VISUAL is descriptive metadata only and is not used to exclude targets or alter scores in V1.

evaluation_order: Read catalog strictly in chronological UTC order.
Close expired forecast windows before processing the current event.
Score the current event as a target against windows opened by earlier events only.
After target scoring, evaluate whether the current event opens a new trigger window.
Write every trigger, window, target, and outcome to an immutable replay log.

benchmarks.B0: Historical event-rate forecast for the same time and spatial band.
benchmarks.B1: Recent-activity persistence forecast without transfer-pressure routes.
benchmarks.rule: No EARTHQUAKE 3D result is interpreted without comparison against B0, B1, and C0.

prohibited_changes_after_freeze: Creating S01-S04 segments to improve results.
Extending windows after a new trigger.
Selecting only the best sensitivity result.
warning_text: Modelo experimental para investigacion retrospectiva. No constituye una alerta oficial, una prediccion determinista ni sustituye la informacion del IGP/CENSIS y otras autoridades competentes.
